abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this device is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found:
No BUSY Bar devices found.
Make sure to check the following:
- BUSY Bar is charged and powered on
- If you want to use Wi-Fi, go to SETTINGS > Wi-Fi and check whether BUSY Bar is connected to the same network than the machine running Home Assistant.
- If you want to use USB, check whether BUSY Bar is connected to the machine running Home Assistant.

zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

device_unreachable.message: Device is no longer reachable. Verify USB and/or Wi-Fi connection.

access_unauthorized.message: Device has been removed from this smart home. Please reconfigure the device.

unknown_device.message: That device is not known to Home Assistant.

device_not_loaded.message: That BUSY Bar is not set up or is not loaded yet.

font_too_tall_for_two_lines.message: The {font} font is too tall for two lines. Use tiny, small, normal, condensed or bold, or send a single line.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Shows a message on the bar's front display. Which layout is used follows from the fields you fill in: a second line, an icon or a background colour each change the drawing.

line_1.name: Line 1
line_1.description: The message. On its own it is centred; long text scrolls.

line_2.name: Line 2
line_2.description: Adds a second line. Leave empty for a single centred line.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: A built-in icon shown on the left. The text shifts right to make room.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: A built-in sound played alongside the message.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the message stays on screen, in seconds.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Show the message even while a Busy session owns the display.

font.name: Font
font.description: Only the shorter fonts fit two lines; the two tallest are for a single line.

background_color.name: Background colour
background_color.description: Fills the panel behind the message.
